help.score_bar_desc: — real-time confidence from the model (YAMNet or MLP). Color changes at threshold.
help.possible_desc: — threshold exceeded several times, early warning
help.refractory_desc: — waiting for sound to stop before re-arming
help.triggers_desc: — N/Xp/Yc — current trigger count / needed for possible / needed for confirmed. Triggers accumulate when score exceeds threshold within a rolling time window.
help.cooldown_detail: — seconds remaining until detector re-arms after a confirmed event.
help.refractory_detail: — after cooldown, waits for score to drop below threshold (or timeout) before allowing new detections.
help.note: Each detector (siren, explosion, UAVs) has its own independent counters and timers.

settings.title: Settings — Siren Detector
settings.subtitle: Settings
detection.mode_desc: Determines how the engine processes audio from multiple sources. Switches on the fly after Save.
detection.round_robin_desc: — one thread processes sources in turn. Lower peak CPU use.
detection.parallel_desc: — one inference thread per source. Sources processed simultaneously, can increase peak CPU use.
detection.interval_desc: Time between model passes for each audio source. Larger values reduce CPU load but delay detections and may miss shorter sounds.
threshold.desc: Minimum confidence score for each sound type. When MLP classifier is active (siren), this applies to the MLP output score.
threshold.siren_desc: MLP confidence score required for each siren detection to count as a trigger. Lower = more sensitive but more false positives.
dsp_setting.desc: Lightweight Conv1D model that skips YAMNet when confident about background, saving CPU.
dsp_setting.enabled_desc: When On, lightweight DSP classifier pre-screens audio before YAMNet. Confident background is skipped, reducing CPU load up to 90%. Disable to always run full YAMNet inference.
click.desc: Suppresses impulse noise (clicks, pops) from INMP441 before inference. Prevents false "Explosion" detections from electrical interference.
engine.no_engines: No locally registered engines are available.
engine.unavailable: Saved selector "{selector}" is not available locally. Its settings are preserved. Register the engine or remove this entry.
engine.restart_note: Changes take effect after the detector restarts. Engine code can only be registered locally; this page does not install or import code.
engine.enable_first: Enable at least one engine to assign a default route.
engine.no_sources_route: No audio sources are currently known. Source-specific routes can be added after a source connects.
engine.desc: Enable locally available engines, edit their manifest-defined settings, and choose which audio sources they receive.
runtime.desc: Live audio delivery health for processing components. Engine lifecycle, version, and startup errors appear in each engine card.
runtime.no_subscribers: No audio-processing components are currently subscribed.
cal.desc: Record ambient background from a microphone so the model learns what is not a siren through this audio source.
cal.tip1: Record 5+ minutes of your typical environment
cal.tip2: Include varied sounds: appliances, street noise, conversations, 3D printers, etc.
cal.tip3: Record multiple sessions at different times of day
cal.tip4: Each source (ESP32 mic, USB mic) needs its own calibration
cal.tip5: After recording, run make retrain to apply
cal.no_recordings: No recordings yet. Use the form above to record background audio.
